problem_text:
A hospital has 9 patients who need to complete 9 different medical tests.

Each patient's treatment plan consists of a sequence of tests, represented as (Testing Room, Duration),
where each pair specifies the room where the test must be performed and the time required to complete it.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the tests must be administered.

Patient schedules:
* P1 requires: (R4, 9) → (R7, 5) → (R8, 8) → (R6, 1) → (R1, 10) → (R3, 3) → (R2, 3) → (R5, 9) → (R9, 10)
* P2 requires: (R6, 1) → (R8, 7) → (R7, 1) → (R9, 8) → (R1, 2) → (R4, 3) → (R2, 5) → (R3, 6) → (R5, 5)
* P3 requires: (R3, 5) → (R8, 3) → (R7, 10) → (R4, 3) → (R1, 2) → (R9, 7) → (R5, 9) → (R2, 8) → (R6, 9)
* P4 requires: (R3, 2) → (R7, 4) → (R8, 2) → (R9, 4) → (R2, 8) → (R6, 4) → (R4, 1) → (R1, 7) → (R5, 6)
* P5 requires: (R5, 4) → (R6, 8) → (R9, 1) → (R3, 9) → (R4, 10) → (R1, 7) → (R2, 6) → (R8, 4) → (R7, 10)
* P6 requires: (R6, 7) → (R5, 3) → (R7, 5) → (R2, 5) → (R9, 10) → (R3, 3) → (R1, 7) → (R4, 1) → (R8, 2)
* P7 requires: (R3, 6) → (R7, 8) → (R4, 9) → (R1, 10) → (R6, 2) → (R2, 3) → (R9, 3) → (R5, 10) → (R8, 10)
* P8 requires: (R1, 1) → (R8, 10) → (R7, 4) → (R3, 3) → (R2, 8) → (R9, 4) → (R5, 9) → (R4, 5) → (R6, 10)
* P9 requires: (R2, 10) → (R3, 5) → (R8, 1) → (R5, 10) → (R1, 7) → (R7, 6) → (R4, 2) → (R9, 6) → (R6, 5)

Each test must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each testing room can only accommodate one patient at a time.
The objective is to schedule all patient tests across the rooms
so that the total completion time for all patients is minimized.
